issues.on_page: Cash and cash equivalents 194,887; Certificates of deposit 58,848; County treasurer cash 3,717
issues.issue: ending_cash leaves out County treasurer cash 3,717, even though the balance sheet line for it has category Cash and Cash Equivalents. The value matches the printed row label, but treating this cash two different ways is questionable.

The same label 'Charges for services' is charges for services/fees on the statement (receipts[7]) and in the General department (detail[6]), but Recreation Fees here. Using the Park department column as evidence is defensible, but the categories are inconsistent.
The capital outlay function comes from the fund name, not a printed function. The FY2022 ruling (user 2026-11-12) says the function is used only when printed.
